description: Traffic Management — Key Corridor — Monthly Performance Report — routes is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Traffic data for key Brisbane City Council managed roads. This routes dataset contains information for the site id, site, site type, distance, region, description, start intersection and end intersection. The Data and resources section of this dataset contains further information for this dataset. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are road, traffic, transport, travel. The portal shows 18 records. The portal shows 2025-03-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
